messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

Anil Bakhla

Inmobi

Yes

senior mobile engineer at inmobi... building the ad tech that powers half the apps on your phone. 7+ years in the ios game with swift and objective-c. that's solid engineering chops right there. what made you stick with mobile development for so long? most folks jump around between web, backend, mobile...
hey anil, i was just thinking about your mobile engineering journey at inmobi... what's the dream role you've been thinking about lately?
Leading a team with making design discussions
